overview: Data Analysts inspect, clean, transform, and model data to uncover actionable insights, trends, and support strategic decision-making.
learning_roadmap: Master SQL: Aggregations, multi-table joins, subqueries, and window functions (ROW_NUMBER, RANK, LEAD/LAG).
Develop Python data manipulation proficiency using Pandas DataFrames and NumPy arrays.
Build interactive business dashboards using Power BI or Tableau with clear storytelling.
Study descriptive statistics, hypothesis testing, and AB testing methodologies.
interview_topics: Complex SQL scenarios (calculating retention rates, cohort analysis, cumulative sums).
Handling missing data, outliers, and data normalization strategies.
Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) process and dashboard KPI selection.
Communicating quantitative findings to non-technical stakeholders.
diu_campus_advice: Analyze datasets relevant to Bangladesh (e.g., telecom, fintech, retail, healthcare) and share insights on LinkedIn and GitHub.

overview: Data Scientists apply statistical methods, machine learning algorithms, and predictive modeling to solve complex predictive problems.
learning_roadmap: Gain deep understanding of linear algebra, multivariable calculus, and probability distributions.
Implement core ML algorithms: Linear/Logistic Regression, Decision Trees, Random Forests, XGBoost, K-Means.
Master feature selection, cross-validation, hyperparameter tuning, and metric evaluation (ROC-AUC, F1-Score).
Deploy basic predictive models as REST APIs using FastAPI or Flask.
interview_topics: Bias-Variance trade-off and regularization techniques (L1 Lasso, L2 Ridge).
Overfitting prevention: Cross-validation, early stopping, pruning.
Precision vs Recall trade-offs in imbalanced classification problems.
Feature engineering techniques for categorical and continuous variables.
diu_campus_advice: Participate in Kaggle competitions and publish detailed walkthrough notebooks. Collaborate with DIU research groups in AI/ML.

overview: Machine Learning Engineers design, train, deploy, and scale production-grade ML and deep learning models inside operational software ecosystems.
core_skills: Cloud Platforms (AWS SageMaker, GCP Vertex AI)
learning_roadmap: Master deep learning architectures: CNNs, RNNs/LSTMs, Transformers, and Attention mechanisms.
Learn HuggingFace ecosystem for NLP (BERT, RoBERTa, LLMs) and Computer Vision.
Implement model serving, latency optimization, model quantization, and batch inference pipelines.
Study MLOps: Automated model retraining, data drift detection, and experiment tracking.
interview_topics: Transformer architecture internals: Multi-head self-attention, positional encoding, and scaling.
Model deployment challenges: Latency, GPU memory limits, quantization (INT8/FP16).
Data pipeline architectures and feature stores.
Fine-tuning techniques: LoRA, QLoRA, Prompt tuning.
diu_campus_advice: Build working open-source demos on Hugging Face Spaces using Streamlit/Gradio and link them in your resume.

overview: Data Engineers build scalable data pipelines, extract-transform-load (ETL) workflows, data warehouses, and distributed processing infrastructure.
learning_roadmap: Learn data warehousing principles: Star schema, Snowflake schema, and slowly changing dimensions (SCD).
Build batch ETL pipelines using Apache Spark and schedule DAGs with Apache Airflow.
Understand real-time stream processing basics with Apache Kafka.
Optimize distributed queries and manage data partitioning.
interview_topics: Spark execution engine: RDDs, DataFrames, transformations vs actions, and shuffling.
Partitioning, bucketing, and clustering in modern columnar data warehouses.
Data consistency and idempotency in pipeline retries.
diu_campus_advice: Focus on DIU Distributed Systems and Database courses. Work on end-to-end data pipeline projects with public open datasets.
